reasons: Hosted 8B self-use challenges current activation hot-path readiness but is not the target Qwen-class 4B.
Resident inverted-index benchmark is synthetic and does not measure the actual current RAE corpus, full graph traversal, provenance filters or update costs.
No implemented G1c current-corpus comparison yet proves answer-quality/recall benefit at lower total latency/context versus SQLite/packet/G1b.
Live FRANK 71-store parity, p99, crash/replay, privacy and CognitiveFrame stale-assembly gates remain incomplete.
positive_evidence: Real hosted 8B proxy shows graph modes can surface relational facts plain FTS misses, preserving reason to keep semantic graph research.
Local 10k-node test shows per-query reload/full scan is avoidable and resident inverted seeding can be orders of magnitude cheaper in the proxy.
Independent 2026 adaptive GraphRAG research supports routing graph use to complex/scattered-evidence queries rather than all queries.
next_gates: benchmark G1c vs SQLite FTS/deterministic packet/G0/G1b with >=50 independent queries
